{
  "decision-audit-placeholder-counts-before-import": "WITH occurrences AS (
  SELECT message_code, token_name, 1 AS delta FROM source_tokens
  UNION ALL
  SELECT message_code, token_name, -1 AS delta FROM translated_tokens
)
SELECT message_code, token_name, SUM(delta) AS count_delta
FROM occurrences
GROUP BY message_code COLLATE BINARY, token_name COLLATE BINARY
HAVING SUM(delta) <> 0
ORDER BY message_code COLLATE BINARY ASC, token_name COLLATE BINARY ASC",
  "decision-balance-crossover-packing-times": "WITH sequence_stats AS (
  SELECT station_code, run_sequence, COUNT(*) AS pair_count,
         AVG(old_seconds - trial_seconds) AS mean_saved
  FROM packing_trials
  WHERE old_seconds IS NOT NULL AND trial_seconds IS NOT NULL
    AND run_sequence IN ('OT', 'TO')
  GROUP BY station_code, run_sequence
)
SELECT station_code, SUM(pair_count) AS complete_pairs, AVG(mean_saved) AS saved_seconds
FROM sequence_stats
GROUP BY station_code
HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
ORDER BY station_code ASC",
  "decision-balance-invoice-across-directed-quotes": "WITH credits AS (
  SELECT i.invoice_id, i.due_eur_cents,
         (i.deposit_usd_cents * a.bid_scaled) / 10000 AS credited_eur_cents
  FROM invoices AS i
  JOIN quotes AS a ON a.desk = 'A' AND a.base = 'USD' AND a.counter = 'EUR'
), balances AS (
  SELECT invoice_id, credited_eur_cents, due_eur_cents - credited_eur_cents AS remaining_eur_cents
  FROM credits
)
SELECT x.invoice_id, x.credited_eur_cents, x.remaining_eur_cents,
       (x.remaining_eur_cents * b.ask_scaled + 9999) / 10000 AS topup_usd_cents
FROM balances AS x
JOIN quotes AS b ON b.desk = 'B' AND b.base = 'EUR' AND b.counter = 'USD'
ORDER BY x.invoice_id COLLATE BINARY ASC",
  "decision-balance-three-gallery-sessions": "SELECT e.demo_code AS early_show, m.demo_code AS middle_show, l.demo_code AS late_show,
       MIN(e.early_visits, m.middle_visits, l.late_visits) AS smallest_audience,
       e.early_visits + m.middle_visits + l.late_visits AS day_visits
FROM demo_forecast AS e
JOIN demo_forecast AS m ON m.demo_code <> e.demo_code
JOIN demo_forecast AS l ON l.demo_code <> e.demo_code AND l.demo_code <> m.demo_code
WHERE e.early_visits IS NOT NULL AND m.middle_visits IS NOT NULL AND l.late_visits IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY smallest_audience DESC, day_visits DESC,
         early_show COLLATE BINARY ASC, middle_show COLLATE BINARY ASC, late_show COLLATE BINARY ASC
LIMIT 1"
}
